+const fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader = "x-flipt-accept-server-version"
+
+var defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion = semver.Version{Major: 1}
+
+type fliptAcceptServerVersionContextKey struct{}
+
+// WithFliptAcceptServerVersion returns a context containing the client's accepted server version.
+func WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(ctx context.Context, version semver.Version) context.Context {
+	return context.WithValue(ctx, fliptAcceptServerVersionContextKey{}, version)
+}
+
+// FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext returns the accepted server version, or the default version.
+func FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx context.Context) semver.Version {
+	if version, ok := ctx.Value(fliptAcceptServerVersionContextKey{}).(semver.Version); ok {
+		return version
+	}
+
+	return defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion
+}
+
+// FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor stores the client's accepted server version in the request context.
+func FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(logger *zap.Logger) grpc.UnaryServerInterceptor {
+	return func(ctx context.Context, req interface{}, info *grpc.UnaryServerInfo, handler grpc.UnaryHandler) (interface{}, error) {
+		version := defaultFliptAcceptServerVersion
+		if values := metadata.ValueFromIncomingContext(ctx, fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader); len(values) > 0 {
+			parsed, err := semver.Parse(strings.TrimPrefix(values[0], "v"))
+			if err != nil {
+				logger.Debug("invalid accepted server version", zap.String("version", values[0]), zap.Error(err))
+			} else {
+				version = parsed
+			}
+		}
+
+		return handler(WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(ctx, version), req)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,58 @@
+package grpc_middleware
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"errors"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/blang/semver/v4"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+	"go.uber.org/zap"
+	"google.golang.org/grpc/metadata"
+)
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(t *testing.T) {
+	assert.Equal(t, semver.Version{Major: 1}, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(context.Background()))
+
+	version := semver.Version{Major: 2, Minor: 3, Patch: 4}
+	ctx := WithFliptAcceptServerVersion(context.Background(), version)
+	assert.Equal(t, version, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+}
+
+func TestFliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		name   string
+		header []string
+		want   semver.Version
+	}{
+		{name: "missing", want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "empty", header: []string{""}, want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "invalid", header: []string{"not-a-version"}, want: semver.Version{Major: 1}},
+		{name: "prefixed", header: []string{"v2.3.4"}, want: semver.Version{Major: 2, Minor: 3, Patch: 4}},
+		{name: "unprefixed", header: []string{"2.3.4"}, want: semver.Version{Major: 2, Minor: 3, Patch: 4}},
+	}
+
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
+			ctx := context.Background()
+			if tt.header != nil {
+				ctx = metadata.NewIncomingContext(ctx, metadata.Pairs(fliptAcceptServerVersionHeader, tt.header[0]))
+			}
+
+			response := new(struct{})
+			handlerErr := errors.New("handler error")
+			called := false
+			got, err := FliptAcceptServerVersionUnaryInterceptor(zap.NewNop())(ctx, nil, nil,
+				func(ctx context.Context, req interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
+					called = true
+					assert.Equal(t, tt.want, FliptAcceptServerVersionFromContext(ctx))
+					return response, handlerErr
+				})
+
+			require.True(t, called)
+			assert.Same(t, response, got)
+			assert.ErrorIs(t, err, handlerErr)
+		})
+	}
+}
